summary: This pack holds the graphics for recorded training courses. It has three animated title covers built at 2560x1440, 25 fps: Обложка #1 (dark stepped «portal» with the course visual inside), #2 (drifting green blocks) and #3 (green portal, light). Each cover ends with a green stair-step wipe («Переход», 2.04 s). The pack also has full-length lecture frames for a 16:9 screencast, a 3:2 screencast and screencast + speaker, built as 1-hour 1920x1080 comps, plus brand pieces: the Logo precomp, a header with tick ruler and tagline, Pattern Arrow.png and Music Intro.mp3. Everything is hand-keyed shape and text layers. There are zero Essential Graphics controllers (CcCt=0 in all comps) and zero effects or expression controls. The only «control» null is broken: the titles read its hidden X/Y. Per-line reveal masks are fixed-width, so the production copies had them deleted. The original .aep is the clean template. The converted AE 2026 file is really a production job: it contains two real course covers wrapped to 3840x2160, a 4K inverted-matte speaker overlay, a screencast edit, 4 missing G:\ files, and a shared «Visual» precomp that was changed for production. The Auto-Save is an intermediate copy. The overlays were shipped as 3 × 600-s ProRes 4444 files (10.0 GB) even though their only motion is a 60-s loopOut drift of six green corner blocks. Plan: each overlay becomes a still or MOGRT frame plus Premiere presets that fit the screencast and speaker into the windows. The covers become one MOGRT family with Responsive Design – Time and a media slot. The transition becomes a short prerender or MOGRT with a CUT marker. Evidence (read-only decode, my own extended RIFX decoder): C:\dev\temp\claude\C--Users------Documents-Cloud-ru-Preset-plugin\b48e0614-1141-4125-9b74-d00eb767441b\scratchpad\work\{orig,conv,auto}_deep.txt (per layer: timing, flags, parent, track matte, keyframes, text styles), work\deep_dump.py and work\aepx.py (ldta calibration notes in the header), work\frames_courses\*.png (full-res overlay and transition frames), work\trans_sheet.png.
canonical_file:
Use the ORIGINAL «Обучающие курсы.aep» (3.76 MB, older AE on Mac, collected 01.12.2025, 13 comps, 79 expressions) as the source of truth for template content. It is the only file that still has the clean placeholder covers: Обложка #1–#3 at 2560x1440 with «Первая строчка / вторая строчка / третья последняя», per-line masks, «Cloud.ru Advanced» label, Kubernetes visual. It also has the overlays 16:9 / 3:2 / speaker (speaker on the LEFT = the layout of render «Оверлей со спикером_1.mov»), Переход and Logo. Its 3 footage files have dead Mac paths (/Volumes/T7_Black/_Video/3_Обучающие курсы/(Footage)/Folder/...), but the same relative (Footage) tree sits next to the .aep, so AE relinks them; the converted file proves it, because it stores the PC paths as existing.

The CONVERTED «(converted).aep» (3.50 MB, re-saved in AE 2026 on Windows 2026-09-30 20:25, 19 comps, 90 expressions) is a production file. Concrete diffs:
(1) Comp id 4 «Обложка #1» became a 3840x2160 wrapper (layer @150 %, Collapse ON) around «Pre-comp 4» = real cover «Продвижение / платформы / Cloud.ru Advanced». So the placeholder cover #1 no longer exists.
(2) New «Обложка #4» (3840x2160 @150 %, Collapse OFF → soft) wraps «Pre-comp 3» = «Миграция, / резервное копирование / и аварийное восстановление» with label «Cloud.ru».
(3) In both production covers the 3 title masks were deleted and «Text Opacity 0» was added to Animator 1. A full-frame «slide_01.png» at 67 % sits on top from 0–6 s; both copies are missing on G:\.
(4) The shared «Visual» precomp was changed: G:\Продвижение Cloud.ru Advanced\3D.png (missing) is now a child of a hidden Kubernetes.png layer. The template Обложка #2 therefore now shows the missing 3D.png, and the «Миграция» cover shows the Advanced course's visual.
(5) «Оверлей со спикером» was rebuilt at 3840x2160: «Pre-comp 1» (white window boxes, hidden) is an ALPHA-INVERTED matte for «Pre-comp 2» (the frame). This is the right way to get transparent windows. But Pre-comp 2 is placed twice; the top copy is frozen by a single HOLD time-remap key and has the 3D switch on.
(6) New «Оверлей со спикером 2» contains two cuts of «Запись экрана 2026-09-01 в 12.42.01.mov» (G:\, missing).
(7) Overlays 16:9 and 3:2, Переход and Logo are unchanged.

The AUTO-SAVE (2026-09-28 18:27, 15 comps) is an intermediate: placeholder covers plus the first, clean 2-layer version of the 4K inverted-matte speaker overlay (no frozen duplicate). It is superseded; delete it.

Decision: rebuild the master «CR_Course_*.aep» from the original. Take only three things from the converted file: the inverted-matte window construction, the mask-free (opacity) reveal idea, and the 4K target. Archive the converted file with its G:\ media as a production job. The 10 .cfa/.pek files are Premiere conformed-audio caches of the Dynamic-Linked converted «Обложка #1»/«#4» (5 generations, 2026-09-29 11:55 → 09-30 20:25). They are disposable.

Each line has 1 fixed rectangular mask (909 / 872 / 1018 px wide) and Animator 1: Range Selector Start 0→100 % (Based on Lines) + Position offset [0,110]. Starts 0.00 / 0.52 / 0.92 s, durations 1.08 / 0.88 / 0.76 s, ease out-influence 9 % → in-influence 69 %. Title X/Y come from expressions on Position_0/1 that read null «Позиция и размер текста». Label «Cloud.ru Advanced » (30 px, tracking +5, #CCCCCC) fades opacity 0→100 from 1.00 to 2.32 s, linear. Precomp «Visual» (2700², Kubernetes.png 1622x1246 scaled 146→154 % over 10 s) sits at 83 % with an ALPHA track matte from «Shape Layer 3»: an 8-vertex stepped polygon 2400x1179, #333333, path keys at 0 / 3.04 / 6.00 s. It also stays visible as the panel. 8 nulls «Shape Layer 3: Path 1 [1.1.0–7]» (Create Nulls from Paths, points()/toComp expressions) drive nothing. The header group is parented to the «Logo» precomp (35 %): a lime #CFF500 rect «Shape Layer 2» (hidden, alpha matte) masks «Shape Layer 1», a 77-px vertical stroke repeated ×250 (Repeater 25 px, Offset expr '-100 + time*0.5'); the tagline «облачные и ИИ-сервисы» is SB Sans Display Semibold 39.6 px, tracking -18. Hard to parametrize because of: fixed masks, a control null with hidden X/Y, a shared «Visual» precomp, and a raster visual upscaled about 1.9x at 4K.

templates.parametrization_plan:
One master «CR_Cover_Portal», 3840x2160 / 25 fps, base 7.04 s.
EGP (labels in Russian, ASCII layer names CTRL / TITLE / LABEL / VISUAL):
- «Заголовок»: one paragraph Source Text, ≤3 lines, font editing off.
- «Продукт»: label Source Text.
- «Визуал»: Media Replacement on a TOP-LEVEL footage layer (image/video), track-matted by the portal path; push-in via scale = 100·linear(time, inPoint, outPoint, 1, 1.055).
- «Вписать/Заполнить»: dropdown.
- «Слоган»: checkbox.
- «Позиция заголовка» (Point) and «Размер заголовка» (Slider) on CTRL.
Text system: one text layer, Animator Based on Lines; per-line stagger from Range Selector expressions (0 / 0.52 / 0.92 s or brand stagger 70–120 ms). Auto-fit: scale = min(100, maxW / sourceRectAtTime().width · 100). Empty lines collapse and the block re-centres. Replace fixed masks with an auto-sized rectangle track matte (sourceRectAtTime + 15 % pad) to keep the masked line-reveal token, or use the production opacity variant.
Delete the path nulls. End BG at the wipe's full-cover frame so the tail is transparent.
Responsive Design – Time: protected intro 0–2.40 s, protected outro = last 2.08 s (wipe); the middle hold stretches.
Music goes out of the comp into an «sfx» cue that the panel places on A1. Expression engine → JavaScript.
Pr panel: sequence.importMGT at the playhead, then fill properties via getMGTComponent().
Ae panel: import CR_Course_Covers.aep, deep-duplicate the cover and its visual slot (prevents the shared-precomp bug), set texts through CTRL.

problems.detail: 0 Essential Graphics controllers (CcCt=0 in all 13/19 comps), no effects or Expression Controls; all text, colours and sizes are hardcoded. A MOGRT cannot be exported meaningfully as-is.
problems.fix: Add a CTRL null with expression controls (ASCII names), expose Source Text / Media Replacement / checkboxes / dropdowns in EGP, and author the MOGRTs.

problems.detail: The three overlays ship as 600.04-s ProRes 4444 (1.54 + 4.25 + 4.22 = 10.0 GB) rendered from 3600-s comps. A 45-min lecture still needs 5 chained copies, with a duplicated frame at each 600.04-s seam. Content is a static frame plus a 60-s loopOut drift of 6 rects. The saved 16:9 / 3:2 / original speaker comps cannot even reproduce the transparent window: they are empty 1-hour edit containers over an opaque BG. The 3:2 layout was never rendered.
problems.fix: Replace with stills (PNG RGBA 4K) plus pr-presets that fit media into the windows; an optional MOGRT frame (3-h comp, loopOut) or a single 60-s seamless loop prerender. Build windows with an ALPHA-INVERTED matte.

problems.detail: Null «Позиция и размер текста» (all covers): its visible Position [1280,720] is not separated, but the title expressions read its hidden xPosition/yPosition (184.27, 386.48). Moving the null does not move the title, and there is no size link despite the name.
problems.fix: Replace it with a Point Control «Позиция заголовка» + Slider «Размер заголовка» on CTRL, exposed in EGP.

problems.detail: Per-line reveal masks are fixed (909 / 872 / 1018 px at 2560) and clip any longer title. The production copies (Pre-comp 3/4) deleted them and added «Text Opacity 0» instead, so the two reveal behaviours now differ.
problems.fix: Use a mask-free reveal or an auto-sized track matte driven by sourceRectAtTime; add auto-fit scaling for long lines.

problems.detail: Mixed canvases: covers and Переход 2560x1440, overlays 1920x1080, wrappers 3840x2160 (@150 % / 200 %). The converted «Обложка #4» wrapper has Collapse OFF, so the 2560 raster is upscaled (soft), while «Обложка #1» has Collapse ON. Kubernetes.png (1622x1246) is upscaled ≈1.9x at 4K. The QHD Переход.mov sits in a «FullHD» folder.
problems.fix: One master canvas 3840x2160 @25 fps for every template; vector or ≥4K visuals; stills and prerenders in 4K + FHD.

problems.detail: Обложка #1 is 7.92 s and its BG lasts to 7.92 (opaque tail after the wipe). #2/#3 are 15.04 s (= music length), with BG ending at 6.00 s and work area 0–7.04 s, so about 8 s of the comp is empty. Music Intro.mp3 has its audio switch OFF in #1, #3 and Pre-comp 3/4 but ON in #2.
problems.fix: Unify: 7.04-s covers, BG cut at the wipe's full-cover frame (transparent tail), music as a separate sfx cue, Responsive Time hold.

problems.detail: Переход reaches 100 % coverage on a single frame (frame 25 = 1.00 s; 0.888 / 0.908 on the neighbouring frames). A cut that is off by one frame, or a 50/60p timeline, shows the cut.
problems.fix: Hold full cover ≥4 frames, add a CUT marker, and have the panel align that marker to the edit point.

problems.detail: Converted 4K «Оверлей со спикером»: «Pre-comp 2» is placed twice. The top copy is frozen (1 HOLD time-remap key at 0) and has the only 3D switch in the whole package; it fully covers the animated copy, so the overlay renders static.
problems.fix: Keep one inverted-matted frame layer (as in the Auto-Save). Decide on static vs animated.

problems.detail: Window aspect does not match the source. The speaker layout's screencast window is 1250x751 (5:3) for a 16:9 recording (≈113 px cropped). The 3:2 window is 1300x900 (13:9) against a 1363x909 precomp (≈63 px cropped). The 16:9 window is offset 10 px from the 85 % precomp (2 % overscan).
problems.fix: Make window aspect equal to source aspect, or expose a crop % control; ship pr-presets with exact fit values.

problems.detail: All three projects use the legacy ExtendScript engine. All expressions (79 / 90) are JavaScript-compatible: loopOut(), '-100 + time*0.5', layer.transform.position links, Create-Nulls-from-Paths points()/toComp.
problems.fix: Switch to the JavaScript engine before authoring MOGRTs; no rewrites needed.

problems.detail: Unused nulls evaluate expressions every frame: 8 path-follow nulls each in Обложка #1, Pre-comp 3 and Pre-comp 4; 1 of 2 in #3 is unused; 8 «save zone» nulls each in the 16:9 and 3:2 overlays. Plus shy/locked decor layers.
problems.fix: Delete them; keep only nulls with children or controls.

problems.detail: 31× «Shape Layer N»; many unnamed footage/precomp layers; «Pre-comp 1–4»; the 16:9 matte is named «Маска 3 на 3»; folder «Folder»; trailing space in «Cloud.ru Advanced »; placeholder typos «Пишем текстр…», «Ававававававава».
problems.fix: Adopt a naming scheme (CTRL_, TXT_, SLOT_, FX_, MATTE_) and ASCII names for anything scripts touch.

problems.detail: The Auto-Save copy is superseded. There are 10 .cfa/.pek files (31.6 MB): Premiere conformed audio for the Dynamic-Linked «Обложка #1/#4», written next to the .aep because the media cache is set to «next to originals». The 3 overlay .mov names are Mac NFD (decomposed «й»).
problems.fix: Delete the Auto-Save and caches; point the Premiere media cache to a central folder; rename to NFC or delete the renders after replacement.

problems.detail: Переход layers start at -9.00 s (keys at 9/11 s). Logo layers run 921 s inside a 14.16-s comp. The music layer runs to 16.48 s past its 15.1-s file. Portal path keys at 7.76 / 7.92 s fall after the layers' 6.00-s out point, so the morph is truncated. The Logo is stretched over 1 h with a time-remap HOLD.
problems.fix: Normalise layer starts and durations during the rebuild; use a still or vector logo instead of time remapping.

problems.detail: SB Sans is not on Adobe Fonts, so a MOGRT needs the fonts installed locally on every Premiere machine (Mac and PC). PostScript names match the PC install in C:\Windows\Fonts (SBSansDisplay-Regular / -Semibold, SBSansText-Regular, v1.002–1.003), but the project's font records carry v1.000 from the Mac, so metrics may drift. The Collect report lists only «SB Sans Display Regular».
problems.fix: Standardise font versions on Mac and PC; add a font check to the panel (app.fonts / TextDocument.font).

problems.detail: Portal fill #333333, label #CCCCCC and logo white #F8F8F8 are not in the brand token set (#222222, #343F48, #F2F2F2, #FFFFFF); lime #CFF500 is used only as a hidden matte. Measured render colours: BG #222222, green #26CF7B ≈ #26D07C.
problems.fix: Map these to tokens or approve them as course-specific tones in cloudru-motion-tokens.json.

problems.detail: «Visual» in Обложка #2 and «Прекомп спикер» in converted Pre-comp 1 have track-matte mode = 1 but no matte layer reference. It has no visual effect but is confusing.
problems.fix: Clear the setting during the rebuild.

cleanup_actions: Delete «Adobe After Effects Auto-Save/Обучающие курсы (converted) auto-save 1.aep» (superseded intermediate, 2.8 MB) after noting its clean 2-layer inverted-matte speaker overlay.

Delete the 10 «Обучающие курсы (converted) Обложка #1/#4.aep 48000*.cfa/.pek» files (31.6 MB of Premiere conform cache). Point the Premiere media cache to a central folder so caches stop landing in package folders.
Move «Обучающие курсы (converted).aep» to a production archive together with its G:\ media (slide_01.png ×2, 3D.png, Запись экрана 2026-09-01 в 12.42.01.mov); do not use it as a template.
After the stills, MOGRTs and loops replace them, delete the three 600.04-s overlay renders (10.0 GB). Until then, rename them from NFD to NFC (decomposed «й» in «Оверлей»).

In the rebuild: remove the 8 unused path-follow nulls in each of Обложка #1 / Pre-comp 3 / Pre-comp 4, the unused one in #3, and the 16 «save zone» nulls; remove the frozen 3D duplicate of Pre-comp 2.
Rename layers and comps (CTRL_, TXT_, SLOT_, MATTE_, FX_ prefixes, ASCII for anything scripted); fix «Маска 3 на 3» and the trailing space in «Cloud.ru Advanced »; replace placeholder typo text.
Switch the expression engine to JavaScript in the new masters; all existing expressions are compatible.
Normalise timing: covers 7.04 s with the BG ending at the full-cover frame; Переход layers start at 0; logo comp length = parent; music out of the comps.
Standardise all masters to 3840x2160 @25 fps. If the converted wrappers are kept temporarily, turn Collapse Transformations ON for the «Обложка #4» layer.
Move «Переход.mov» (2560x1440) out of «Render Overlays/FullHD» or re-render at the proper sizes.

Re-collect the new template project with a relative (Footage) tree only (no G:\ or /Volumes paths). List all three fonts (SBSansDisplay-Regular, SBSansDisplay-Semibold, SBSansText-Regular) in the package readme, since the Collect report under-reports them.
questions_for_user: Pre-comp 3 and Pre-comp 4 each have a full-frame «slide_01.png» (67 %, visible 0–6 s, ABOVE the titles; both files missing on G:\). Is the real cover meant to be the deck's title slide, or is this an alignment reference that was left on?

Converted 4K «Оверлей со спикером»: the top copy of Pre-comp 2 is frozen at frame 0 (with a 3D switch) and hides the animated copy. Do you want the lecture frames static or with the slow corner drift?

Which speaker layouts should ship: speaker left (original comp and «…_1.mov»), speaker right («Оверлей со спикером.mov» and the converted Pre-comp 1), or both? Is the 3:2 frame still used? It was never rendered.
Covers and music: only Обложка #2 has Music Intro.mp3 switched on. Should the plugin place the 15-s intro cue automatically under every cover, or never?

What are the delivery targets: FHD, 4K or both? Are sequences always 25p, or also 50p/60p? This matters for the 1-frame wipe cut and the MOGRT frame rate. Which AE and Premiere versions run on the Mac? This sets the MOGRT minimum version and whether masters must stay AE 2025-compatible.
Subtitles: are burned-in subtitles made in Premiere captions (SRT/transcription) or must they keep the AE plate look?
Is there a library of per-course visuals (Figma exports like Kubernetes.png / 3D.png) that the cover media slot should browse?
